title: Pure Bystial
summary: The Bystial monsters plus the three Branded Continuous cards that name Bystial, with generic Dragon Xyz Monsters, Links and staples. The Fallen of Albaz Fusion line from the page has its own list (Branded). Every Level 6 Bystial summons itself from the hand by banishing a LIGHT or DARK monster from either GY, as a Quick Effect once the opponent controls a monster. That makes them hand traps that eat the opponent's GY. The Bystial Lubellion tributes a Level 6 or higher DARK Dragon to summon itself, discards itself to search a Bystial, and places a Branded Continuous card from the Deck. Branded Beast destroys a card by tributing a Dragon, Branded Befallen negates effects aimed at your Bystials, and Branded Regained draws and revives Bystials. The Bystial Aluber, the newest card, is a Tuner that steals or revives their Dragon. Bystial Dis Pater revives banished monsters and negates. Bystial Magnamhut and Druiswurm are Limited.

allow.Branded Beast: Needs a Bystial monster; The Bystial Lubellion places it from the Deck.
allow.Branded Befallen: Protects Bystial monsters; The Bystial Lubellion places it from the Deck.
allow.Branded Regained: Revives Bystial monsters; The Bystial Lubellion places it from the Deck.
